 The ET Maharashtra Urban Transformation Summit 2026, an initiative by ET Government, The Economic Times Business Vertical, will bring together government leaders, policymakers, urban authorities, infrastructure institutions, developers, investors, technology companies and industry leaders to explore the future of Maharashtra's cities.
